translations.web: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself; for emptiness will be his reward.
translations.bsb: Let him not deceive himself with trust in emptiness, for emptiness will be his reward.
translations.kjv: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.
translations.asv: Let him not trust in vanity, deceiving himself; For vanity shall be his recompense.
